targets.review_note: Published example establishes live expression definitions, not eager assignment: a:=b+c before b/c definitions later prints8 then13 after b changes. Parse +,-,* with multiplication precedence into postfix; save expression per variable; evaluate fresh on PRINT with per-print memoization, so redefinitions invalidate old computed values. RESET removes definitions. Undefined dependency or dependency cycle yields UNDEF rather than inventing a numeric value. Unary signs are handled without Python eval. Text gives no data bound; exercise long shared dependency chains and arithmetic independently.
